pokedexEntries.x: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.

pokedexEntries.y: The frills on either side of its head have cells that generate electricity when exposed to sunlight.

pokedexEntries.sw: When spread, the frills on its head act like solar panels, generating the power behind this Pokémon’s electric moves.

pokedexEntries.sh: The sun powers this Pokémon’s electricity generation. Interruption of that process stresses Helioptile to the point of weakness.
